briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race toward multi-agent AGI milestones

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has intensified with new frontier releases from major labs. Funding remains robust while safety concerns mount around deployment scale. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI shipped o4 with advanced agent orchestration. Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus and Meta open-sourced Llama 4. xAI and DeepSeek launched competing 1T parameter models this week.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New red-teaming reports highlight persistent jailbreak vectors across agents. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC announced 2nm AI chip ramp for 2027. Microsoft and Google expanded data center capacity by 40% in Q2. NVIDIA Blackwell supply constraints persist into late 2026.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols outpace centralized safety frameworks by 2027?
